[[File:Dale Hanak DecipherCon 1999 sat46.jpg|thumb|right|260px|At [[DecipherCon 1999]]. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Dale Hanak''' finished 3rd in the [[Young Jedi]] World Championship at [[DecipherCon 2002]], winning $150.<ref name="pc-nov02">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/november02archives.htm November Updates], Josh Radke, swccgpc.com (3 November 2002). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030423221953/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/november02archives.htm Internet Archive]</ref> At [[DecipherCon 1999]] he played the [[Star Trek CCG]] World Championship, finishing 7th on Day 1 and 9th on Day 2.<ref name="dc99st02_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/ST02_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: 1999 ST World Championships], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001031210057/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/ST02_1.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99st03_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/ST03_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: 1999 ST World Championships Day 2], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001219092400/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/ST03_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>
